title: Rahul Kishore pitches Axon Enterprise at Sohn 2026
description: Founder of Epicenter Capital Rahul Kishore highlights Axon Enterprise and how AI agents are transforming organizational efficiency as part of "Next Wave" at the 2026 Sohn Investment Conference.
summary: The pitch argues that Axon Enterprise is a winner in the artificial intelligence sector. The presenter forecasts that the company's revenues will nearly triple and its profits will grow even more over the next three years, leading to a stock price that doubles in that period.
thesis: The pitch argues that Axon Enterprise is a winner in the artificial intelligence sector. The presenter forecasts that the company's revenues will nearly triple and its profits will grow even more over the next three years, leading to a stock price that doubles in that period.

claims.claim: The presenter believes Axon is an AI winner that will double over the next three years, with revenues nearly tripling and profits growing more than that.
claims.quote: I believe that Axon can double over the next 3 years. I expect revenues can nearly triple and profits more than that. And assuming that we don't have any multiple appreciation from current levels, you know, we can make that double over 3 years and probably more as people realize this is clearly one of those AI winners that is transforming what can happen over the next decade.
